text:
emma: quick update from the quant mini-scan on nova-lite-13b. int6 looks like the sweet spot for latency vs regressions.

li: numbers?

emma: fp16 p50 84ms, cost $120/1M. int6 p50 68ms cost ~$50/1M. per-channel-int4 p50 60ms cost ~$38/1M.

rohan: quality tradeoffs?

emma: weighted ROUGE-L loss: int6 ~ -0.7, per-channel-int4 ~ -1.6. biggest hits on citation and numeric slices.

li: routing idea?

emma: default -> per-channel-int4, but predicate fallback to int6 when: tokens>300 OR contains URL/citation regex OR numeric-heavy (>4 numbers). enterprise users always route to int6 by default.

infra-bot: rollout tasks: add routing flag quant.default=pc-int4, metric quant_fallback_rate, 24h shadow int6 3% traffic, alert if fallback_rate>8% for 15m.

rohan: ML: run a 36h targeted sweep toggling attention vs ff per-channel quant to see citation sensitivity. need 2xA100-80GB.

li: small scorecard stub:
"""
slice general: FP16 RL44.0 | PC-INT4 43.0 | delta -1.0 | cost ratio 0.32
slice citation: FP16 RL47.0 | PC-INT4 45.4 | delta -1.6 | cost ratio 0.32
avg cost: FP16 $120 | INT6 $50 | PC-INT4 $38
"""

emma: assigned rohan for sweep, infra for routing. I'll own the 50-case citation eval and weekly scorecard.

li: leaning hybrid with these predicates. publish GTN blurb after the 36h sweep.

infra-bot: reminder set for canary check in 72h.
